description:
[read-only] The brand's best ads in a date range, sorted by spend, conversions, clicks, impressions or roas, with creative thumbnail and metrics. roas is null unless results carry a purchase value (hasValue says whether any do). Read only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/top-ads.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

connection.description: One ad account (`key` from a previous answer). Default: all of the brand's.

from.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the configured number of days before `to`.

limit.description: Ads to return (default and maximum are configured).

sort.description: spend, conversions, clicks, impressions or roas (default: spend). `sorts` in the answer lists them.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. The range has a configured maximum.

name: ads_top_ads
title: Ads ranked by performance
